style: Bad MS Paint doodle drawn by someone with no drawing skill, deliberately crude, clumsy and funny. Plain white background. Thick uneven wobbly black marker outlines. Stick figures with round heads, dot eyes, simple line mouths, straight stick limbs. Flat solid color fills only, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no text, no letters, no words. Vertical portrait composition.
rurik: a small doodle sphynx cat named Rurik: hairless with pale pink skin, wrinkly, huge pointy ears, big round eyes, skinny tail (the only colored thing in the picture)
pureum: a round fluffy grey doodle cat

scenes.01: OWNER standing confused with many big question marks scribbled around his head, RURIK sitting beside him looking up.
scenes.02: OWNER flipping through a huge thick dictionary, RURIK next to him with a flat unimpressed face.
scenes.03: OWNER in front of a laptop whose screen is completely black, his eyes wide and startled, RURIK peeking from behind.
scenes.04: Close-up of a big black rectangle screen, completely empty except one thin white vertical bar in the middle, tiny scribbled sparkle around it.
scenes.05: OWNER frozen stiff in front of a laptop, both hands hovering above the keyboard, sweat drops flying off his head. Above him a cloud-shaped thought bubble containing only a tiny doodle laptop with a scribbled orange explosion burst, absolutely no letters or writing inside the bubble.
scenes.06: RURIK yawning with a huge open mouth in the foreground, OWNER still frozen in front of the black screen in the background.
scenes.07: OWNER pressing a single key with one finger, on the black screen appears one big white question mark.
scenes.08: Black laptop screen with several white speech bubbles popping out of it one after another, OWNER leaning in with big round surprised eyes.
scenes.09: OWNER and a small boxy doodle robot both holding magnifying glasses, looking for a tiny scribbled bug on the floor.
scenes.10: Left side: a tall pile of thick textbooks with a big red X over it. Right side: one small puzzle piece with a big green circle around it.
scenes.11: OWNER holding a phone with a big arrow on the screen, his finger swiping, a stopwatch doodle floating above his head.
scenes.12: A phone screen showing two doodle cats: RURIK with huge ears and PUREUM the round grey cat. Next to the phone the real RURIK gives a thumbs up with his paw.
scenes.13: OWNER jumping in the air with joy holding a phone, a paper airplane flying out of the phone.
scenes.14: A chat speech bubble containing an empty blank white rectangle, around it several stick figures with closed eyes ignoring it.
scenes.15: OWNER poking a button on a phone repeatedly with a finger, nothing happens, his face gone pale white with a wavy worried mouth.
scenes.16: OWNER holding a hammer, standing next to a checklist with items being checked off one by one.
scenes.17: RURIK sitting inside a cardboard box with a blank stare, OWNER working hard on a laptop in the background.
scenes.18: OWNER surrounded by eight floating phone app icon squares, his own face is the most shocked with wide eyes and open mouth.
scenes.19: Four big app icons in a row: an arrow, a market tent, a tarot card with a star, two overlapping speech bubbles.
scenes.20: Night scene with a crescent moon and stars, OWNER sitting face to face with a laptop, speech bubbles going back and forth between them.
scenes.21: OWNER standing with a single dark scribbled rain cloud right above his head.
scenes.22: Three envelopes each with a big red X scribbled on it, OWNER with slumped shoulders and a sad line mouth.
scenes.23: OWNER dropping a fourth envelope into a mailbox, RURIK next to him sighing with a small puff cloud.
scenes.24: RURIK facing the viewer directly, one front paw raised like giving a speech, nothing else around.
scenes.25: OWNER crouched on the ground hugging a big question mark, drawn small and alone in the center.
scenes.26: OWNER standing with both arms raised high in triumph, a rainbow arc of small app icon squares behind him.
scenes.27: OWNER digging a hole with a shovel, dirt flying, a phone lying at the bottom of the hole.
scenes.28: RURIK tapping a doodle bell shape with his paw, OWNER in the background bowing politely.
